recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Changing current source back to dicm would conflict with later DICOM/FHIR terminology decisions, and there is no remaining core source correction for FHIR-5570.
issue_request: FHIR-5570 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core terminology-valuesets correction asking that DICOM code system uses of http://nema.org/dicom/dcid be replaced with http://nema.org/dicom/dicm.
initial_application: Historical git commit ce4fa67b0458b398c8a66215012d0b7f3d6f84ea, corresponding to SVN r3985, explicitly applied the issue by replacing dcid with dicm across the then-current DICOM code system, value sets, examples, and spreadsheets.
additional_context: Later DICOM terminology work superseded the historical dicm URI with http://dicom.nema.org/resources/ontology/DCM. FHIR-12944 clarified DICOM code-system page wording, FHIR-12947 tracked DICOM-derived value-set consistency, and FHIR-24908 moved core toward DICOM-published terminology URIs; these related issues are already represented on the combined reconciliation branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Exact current-source searches found no http://nema.org/dicom/dcid or http://nema.org/dicom/dicm uses, while active DICOM-coded examples and value sets use http://dicom.nema.org/resources/ontology/DCM.

related_jiras.note: Clarified DICOM code-system wording and accepted different description/canonical page URLs after the historical dicm URI was questioned.
Tracked consistency of DICOM-derived value sets and the move toward DICOM-owned value-set definitions.
Directed core to eliminate duplicate local DICOM terminology and use DICOM-published URIs directly.
